mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, input_store_uuid, session_ids, instructions, model, status, output_store_uuid, error, created_at, updated_at, archived_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dreams ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, input_store_uuid, session_ids, instructions, model, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.InputStoreUUID}, CAST(#{params.SessionIDs,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.Instructions}, #{params.Model}, #{params.Status}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE dreams SET output_store_uuid = #{params.OutputStoreUUID}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status = 'running'

UPDATE dreams SET error = #{params.Error}, status = 'failed', updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status = 'running'

UPDATE dreams SET archived_at = COALESCE(archived_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{externalID} AND archived_at IS NULL AND status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')
